answer_4.quote: We benchmark a series of state-of-the-art models, including seven LLMs and eight VLMs, on the Foodie dataset using zero-shot evaluation. By comparing their performance to human accuracy, we highlight the gap between open-weights and closed-weights models and demonstrate their limitations in understanding Chinese regional food culture.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to answer the questions based on their knowledge without using search engines, this makes the task challenging as it would be hard for one to answer questions about unfamiliar foods and regions without any other available information besides names of the food.
